literal: Birth is equal to all living beings; distinction is not alike because of the differences in deeds done.
translation: All living beings are equal by birth; their distinctions arise only from the differences in the deeds they perform.
modern: எல்லா உயிர்களுக்கும் பிறப்பு என்பது சமமானது; ஆனால் அவர்கள் செய்யும் செயல்களின் வேறுபாடுகளால் அவர்களுக்குரிய சிறப்புகள் சமமாவதில்லை.
explanation: This couplet establishes the fundamental equality of all living beings at the moment of birth. While birth is a common, equalizing factor for everyone, true greatness or distinction is not inherent or predetermined. Instead, individuals are distinguished solely by the quality and nature of the actions they perform throughout their lives. Thus, one's worth is defined by their deeds, not by their birth.
